meta.name: Implement Code Fix
meta.description: Fixes the root cause of a clarified, reproduced bug and makes its regression tests pass, then runs the Review and Fix workflow on the result. Unattended. Usually a step of Bug Fix; can also start from the chat when the bug folder under specs/bugs/ already exists.

nodes.title: Start
nodes.description: Run as a Bug Fix step, or name the bug folder under specs/bugs/ to fix.

nodes.title: Implement fix
nodes.description: Fixes the root cause in dazl-pr-panel-sandbox, makes the regression tests pass and runs each touched repository's checks.
nodes.prompt: This step is automatic: never ask a question. Fix every in-scope bug in specs/bugs/<bug-slug>/bug.md using investigation.md and reproduction.md, make the reproduce step's regression tests pass, and run each touched repository's checks on what you changed.

nodes.title: Review and fix
nodes.description: Runs Review and Fix on the fix: six reviewers in a fix loop with the Review Fixer, until no blocker or major finding is open (at most 3 rounds).
nodes.instruction: Review the bug fix that the Implement Code Fix workflow just made, not the bug report. Work in dazl-pr-panel-sandbox/. The branch under review is that repository's currently checked-out run branch, including its uncommitted changes. Compare it against origin/main. The bug and its root cause are described in the newest folder under specs/bugs/ (bug.md, investigation.md, reproduction.md); reviewers should check the fix addresses that root cause and keeps its regression tests meaningful.
